name: agent-rail
description: A live progress rail for Claude Code and Codex jobs: steps, agents, tokens and history, kept in local files under ~/.agent-rail

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: free only watches the agents; railed also asks them for a title, a staged plan and progress notes (a few more tokens). The AGENT_RAIL_MODE environment variable overrides it.

openPane.title: Open the pane at start
openPane.description: Open the Agent rail pane when a session starts. Off: it opens only when you run /rail.

band.title: Rail above the prompt
band.description: While the pane is not shown, draw the current job in a few lines above the prompt.
